<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "What does Quantum Business Solutions do?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Quantum Business Solutions is a HubSpot Diamond Partner and B2B Revenue Operations consultancy. We specialize in AI-augmented sales operations, ConnectAndSell implementation, ZoomInfo integration, and our proprietary Q2 Platinum Revenue Operations Framework. We serve office equipment dealers, MSPs, IT services providers, and commercial real estate firms."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Who is Quantum Business Solutions for?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "We serve B2B revenue teams with 5-50 people, primarily in office equipment, managed services, IT services, and commercial real estate. Our typical client has HubSpot Pro+ or wants to migrate to HubSpot, and needs a partner to take their revenue operations from chaotic to systematized."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "How much does an AI Workforce Assessment cost?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "The AI Workforce Assessment & Implementation Program is $9,500 for an 8-week paired delivery engagement. The fee is due upfront on signed SOW, invoiced Net 15 via QuickBooks. Quantum also offers a free 22-question AI Readiness Assessment as a top-of-funnel diagnostic."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Is Quantum Business Solutions a HubSpot Diamond Partner?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Yes. Quantum is a HubSpot Diamond Partner — one of the highest tiers in HubSpot's solutions partner program. We have certified experts across Sales Hub, Marketing Hub, Service Hub, Operations Hub, and CMS Hub."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Who runs Quantum Business Solutions?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Shawn Peterson is the Principal and leads strategy on every Q2 Platinum and AI Workforce Assessment engagement. Shawn has 20+ years of B2B revenue operations experience across hundreds of organizations, with recent focus on AI-augmented revenue operations."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "What is the Q2 Platinum Revenue Operations Framework?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Q2 Platinum is Quantum's proprietary methodology for systematizing B2B revenue operations. It organizes revenue data work into the 5 Cs: Capture, Cleanse, Combine, Calculate, Communicate. Q2 is delivered as a productized engagement with defined hour ranges and templated deliverables."
      }
    }
  ]
}
</script>

<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Instrument+Serif:ital@0;1&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* variables */
:root{--ql-bg:#080b12;--ql-fg:#e2e5eb;--ql-gold:#c4a44a;--ql-gold-bright:#d4ba6a;--ql-gold-dim:#9a7d3f;--ql-navy:#101725;--ql-void:#080b12;--ql-muted:#8a8f9b;--ql-border:rgba(196,164,74,0.12);--ql-card-bg:rgba(255,255,255,0.02)}
/* layout */
.ql-v3-wrapper{position:relative;z-index:10}
.ql-serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",serif;letter-spacing:-0.03em}
.ql-gold-gradient-text{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f0dca0,#c9a961 40%,#9a7d3f);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text}
.ql-eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.2em;color:var(--ql-gold);margin-bottom:24px;font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif}
.ql-eyebrow::before{content:'';display:block;width:24px;height:1px;background:var(--ql-gold)}
.ql-container{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;position:relative}
.ql-section{padding:64px 0;position:relative}
.ql-grid-2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.ql-grid-4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}
.ql-stat-glow{text-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(196,164,74,0.3)}
@media(min-width:768px){.ql-grid-2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.ql-grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.ql-section{padding:80px 0}}
@media(min-width:1024px){.ql-grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
/* buttons */
.ql-btn-gold{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f0dca0,#c9a961 40%,#9a7d3f);color:#080b12;font-weight:600;font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif;padding:12px 32px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;font-size:14px;border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 0.2s,box-shadow 0.2s}
.ql-btn-gold:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(196,164,74,0.3);color:#080b12}
.ql-btn-outline{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(196,164,74,0.2);color:var(--ql-gold);font-weight:600;font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif;padding:12px 32px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.2s}
.ql-btn-outline:hover{background:rgba(196,164,74,0.05);color:var(--ql-gold)}
/* cards */
.ql-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ql-card-bg);border:1px solid var(--ql-border);border-radius:12px;padding:32px;transition:all 0.5s}
.ql-card:hover{border-color:rgba(196,164,74,0.25);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(196,164,74,0.06)}
.ql-card-accent::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(196,164,74,0.5),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity 0.4s}
.ql-card:hover .ql-card-accent::before{opacity:1}
.ql-icon-box{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(196,164,74,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(196,164,74,0.1);flex-shrink:0}
.ql-icon-box svg{width:24px;height:24px;color:var(--ql-gold);stroke:var(--ql-gold);fill:none;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
/* effects */
.ql-glow-orb{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(100px);pointer-events:none}
.ql-glow-gold{background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,164,74,0.18),transparent 70%)}
.ql-glow-blue{background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(60,130,200,0.08),transparent 70%)}
@keyframes ql-glow{0%,100%{opacity:0.6;filter:blur(80px)}50%{opacity:1;filter:blur(100px)}}.ql-glow-anim{animation:ql-glow 4s ease-in-out infinite}
/* faq */
.ql-faq-item{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(196,164,74,0.08)}
.ql-faq-item summary{cursor:pointer;padding:20px 0;font-family:'Instrument Serif',serif;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--ql-fg);list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.ql-faq-item summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.ql-faq-item summary::after{content:'+';font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--ql-gold);transition:transform 0.3s}
.ql-faq-item[open] summary::after{content:'−'}
.ql-faq-item p{padding:0 0 20px;font-size:14px;color:var(--ql-muted);line-height:1.7;margin:0}
</style>

.kl-testimonial__footer {
  color: #1a1a2e !important;
  margin-top: 16px !important;
}

/* === Section heading "What our customers say" was rendering oversized === */
.kl-rich-text h2 {
  color: #ffffff !important;
  font-size: 2rem !important;
  margin-bottom: 24px !important;
}
.kl-rich-text__preheader {
  color: #c4a44a !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
}
</style>

params.subhead: We systemize, optimize, and automate your entire go-to-market, so sales and marketing finally run as one compounding engine.

params.prose:
The hidden costs killing your profits

Your team is drowning in manual work

Hours lost to repetitive tasks that should be automated.

Systems don't talk

Data silos creating blind spots and duplicate work.

Revenue slipping through the cracks

Leads going cold, deals stalling, opportunities missed.

Can't see what's happening

No single source of truth across your operations.

Expensive tools collecting dust

Paying for software that never got properly implemented.

Growth harder than it should be

Scaling means hiring more people instead of working smarter.

Change the game with the only growth agency HubSpot, ZoomInfo, and ConnectAndSell depend on for customer success

We are a top-tier partner with the best sales and marketing tech providers in the world, the only growth agency that HubSpot, ZoomInfo, and ConnectAndSell hand-pick to deliver outstanding results for their clients. Using world-class tools, we revolutionize sales and marketing performance with our comprehensive approach to the Revenue Generation cycle that optimizes conversion rates.

Most firms sell tools. We deliver outcomes.

We don't implement AI, HubSpot, or automation in isolation. We design systems that increase profit, reduce friction, and scale without adding complexity.

Outcome-first approach

Every engagement starts with your P and L, not a product pitch.

Unified systems

AI, automation, and ops work together as one engine.

Measurable ROI

You'll see the impact in your numbers within 90 days.

Delivering inbound marketing and outbound sales success

We empower businesses aspiring to boost their sales by 20 percent or more and amplify their sales velocity by 10 times within 180 days. We lift the burden for them by evaluating and systemizing their go-to-market strategy, building integrated, automated sales and marketing platforms, and delivering services that optimize revenue operations.

We deliver a faster time to value than any other growth agency

Our focus on optimization, automation, and systematization is key to success. This holistic strategy not only drives top-line sales growth, it enhances overall business value by modernizing and elevating your team's capabilities, processes, and technological tools.
